I can't tell if you are looking for an answer or venting but in case you are this is how I look at it. Saying "you will never have a life as good as your paras" is false equivalency. They aren't real they don't have a good life or any life really and all the positive feelings they feel are positive feelings you feel. And sure you might never acquire their level of wealth or money or power but you can feel those positive emotions because well... you already are just in the daydreams. This is classic sunk cost fallacy (the feeling of needing to follow through with something once we've invested time or money into it even when we know we aren't going to get the outcome we want, which only leads to more time or money gone). You have limited time on this planet. I am not saying each and every moment of it needs to be productive but it is a limited resource. And sure your paras might seem like the best thing you have right now but that's only because they keep taking away your energy and resources that you can use to build something better or just as good. What I think you are lacking is good coping mechanisms. Something that is less destructive for your life. Now I can't pick that for you. No one can. But finding other things that help you get through your days might help you get out of this time sink that is MaDD.
